# Shri Trinetra Mahakal Mandir & Registered Charitable Trust

> Digital sanctuary for Shri Trinetra Mahakal Mandir and its registered Dharmic NGO. Dedicated to sacred Mandir construction (from Neev to Shikhar), authentic Vedic Yagya & Anushthans for resolving Tantrik Badhas and paranormal afflictions, and transparent humanitarian seva including Anna Daan (Mahaprasad Bhandara), Granth Daan, and Shiksha Seva with 80G tax benefits.

- [Mandir Nirman Seva](/mandir-nirman): Micro-donations for temple construction including 1 Sacred Shila (₹1,100), 1 Bag Cement (₹350), 1 Sq. Ft. Sanctum Floor (₹2,100), and Yagyashala Pillar Seva with direct UPI QR & 80G receipts.

- [Registered NGO Charity](/ngo-seva): Daily Anna Daan Mahaprasad Bhandara, free spiritual literature (Bhagavad Gita) distribution, and Shiksha Seva for underprivileged children.
- [Sanctum Pilgrimage & Darshan](/contact): Mandir location, darshan timings, visiting guidelines, and 24/7 Acharya WhatsApp helpline.
